caption: Ara Pacis, Rome
composition: Meier glass pavilion enclosing the white marble Ara Pacis Augustae · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands before the Ara Pacis museum at early afternoon, the stark white modernist pavilion filling the frame. Its long glass wall runs across the center, the carved white marble of the ancient altar clearly visible inside, while the solid stone end of the building closes the right side. The modelled 23 September 2026, 13:30 sun is hard and high, sharpening the clean geometry of the pavilion against a bright blue sky, with umbrella pines and the Tiber embankment at the far left.
